        "The opener supplies only notification.id to the scheduler. The current no-window scheduler path runs its state callback and awaits a per-wait promise; cleanup can reject it when invalidated. The opener catches any rejection, without checking an error subtype, and returns undefined from the async call. Its comment describes dismissal as the intended cause; no independent proof of every rejection cause is inferred.",
        "The added unit task swaps in a scheduler stub, starts openLink without retaining its promise, asserts zero external loads and a called flag, rejects, waits a tick and 1,000 ms, then checks zero loads again. The arbitrary timeout has a local mozilla/no-arbitrary-setTimeout exception; it is accepted scoped code, not a new preferred readiness rule.",
        "The task's direct oracle is MockExternalProtocolService.urls, whose loadURI implementation records URLs unless a deferred was configured. Adjacent successful donation_tab unit cases expect one external URL in this setup. These assertions do not directly measure a content tab, documentGlobal.focus, native foreground application focus, notification replacement races or assistive-technology behavior.",
        "The new three assertion sites have nonempty messages. Missing should alone is not reported as a defect in this authored patch. However, the message promise is awaited is attached to a called flag set before awaiting the stub promise; that assertion identifies invocation, not completion. A more exact message would say the opener should request the user-activity wait.",

Registering harness cleanup before replacement would make this temporary global mutation easier to contain; this is a scoped test-maintenance finding, not an observed later test failure. The test also places a complex multiline assertion next to another call; separating state setup, actions and checks is a readability suggestion distinct from its local formatter output.",
